candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, the method only sets the new password and updates the user. It never revokes existing sessions, for example with this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }). The refresh token flow checks only that the session exists, so a device that was already signed in keeps a valid session and can keep renewing its login after the reset. The profile-update path (around line 469) does invalidate other sessions on a password change, but the reset path doesn't.

fix.description: After updating the password in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions by calling await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id }). Do this so every device has to sign in again.
